title.narrative: UNIDO Country Program of technical cooperation to promote ISID in Madagascar (2018-2022)

description.narrative: The Ministry in charge of Industry and Private Sector Development (MIDSP) requested UNIDO's support on the formulation of a Country Program for Madagascar, during the meeting with UNIDO DG in November 2017 and also through a formal letter dated 02 March 2018. The Country Program would address 7 priority areas of intervention where UNIDO's support is solicited.
